body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Sylvania displayed its 8.9-inch netbook at the Intel booth during 2009 CES, which is powered by Intel Atom processor. Featuring 80GB HDD, it is available for 299(USD).
